transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I came in because… I don’t know, nothing feels like mine anymore. I used to get excited about things—painting murals, going for runs, playing basketball, even making a good drink at work. Now I just kind of stand there and don’t care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months now. It started after the bar got bought out and everything I’d been working toward there just… changed. Since then it’s been like this.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d call it “down” all day, but… yeah, most days I feel pretty low. It’s kind of there in the background a lot.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable, like painting or playing basketball?

Yeah. I don’t really get anything out of them now. Painting, running, basketball… even making a drink right at work used to feel good. Lately I just kind of stand there and it’s like I don’t care about any of it.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level, appetite, or ability to focus lately?

Yeah, my energy’s been pretty bad. Like, by the time I carry a couple cases of liquor or set up the well at work, my body feels like I’ve already worked a double, even if I barely did anything that day.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah. I keep thinking I’ve let people down… the younger bartenders, and some artists I told I’d help make space for. It feels like I wrecked their chance somehow, and then I think maybe I deserve whatever comes from that.
Have you found it harder to focus or make decisions lately, even about small things?

Yeah, definitely. Inventory used to be automatic for me, but now I’ll just stare at the bottles and lose count over and over. Even small stuff, like deciding what garnish to restock, I kind of freeze up and can’t just pick one.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently, like losing or gaining a lot without trying?

Yeah… I think I’ve lost some, though I haven’t really been tracking it. Most days I just forget to eat until my hands start shaking behind the bar. Then after closing I’ll grab a few bites of something cold, but even looking at it kind of makes me feel sick.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower, exactly. At work I probably look normal enough, just kind of tired. Sitting still… I don’t know, I haven’t paid much attention to that.
Have you ever felt so slowed down that even simple tasks took a lot of effort, or on the flip side, have you felt restless or fidgety without being able to settle down?
I don’t really know. I mean, simple stuff feels harder lately, but I can’t tell if it’s because I’m actually slowed down or just… worn out. I haven’t noticed being especially fidgety either.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things for a couple weeks or more?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had bad stretches before, like anyone, but I don’t really know if it was like this or lasted a couple weeks. I haven’t kept track of it that way.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more, before this current episode started?
I honestly don’t know. I’ve had times where I felt low or wasn’t enjoying much, but I couldn’t say for sure if it lasted two weeks or more before this. I never really kept track like that.
Can you recall if you ever had a time before this current episode where you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of two weeks or more?
I can’t really recall a clear time like that before this. I know I’ve had rough patches, but I don’t remember if they lasted two weeks or more or if it was just a few bad days here and there.
Can you think back and recall if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for a full two weeks or more?
I really can’t think of a definite time before this where it went on that long. I’ve had bad weeks or felt off before, but I can’t say it was a full two weeks or more.
Can you recall if there was a time before this current episode when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it wasn’t as severe as now?
I’m still not really sure. I’ve had times before where I felt down or didn’t care much about things, but I can’t say for sure it was more than two weeks. I just didn’t keep track of it like that.

Can you think back over the past few years and recall if there was ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a full two weeks or more, even if it wasn’t as severe as what you’re experiencing now?

I’ve been trying to think back, but I really don’t have a clear memory of that happening for a full two weeks or more. I’ve had stretches where I felt low or just not interested, but I can’t say how long they lasted.
